day_definition: UTC calendar day 2026-11-10, hours 00:00 up to 2026-11-11T00:00:00Z UTC (24 of 24 hours so far)

method_note.counting_changed: On 2026-10-17 counting changed from the $TICKER cashtag to the BARE ticker (TICKER without $), because the free x tools now strip '$' from queries ('$ was removed from query'). Bare counts include plain-text mentions (and company-name mentions where the ticker is the name), so they are NOT directly comparable with counts before 2026-10-17. Ranking uses mentions_clean_est = bare count x the share of sampled posts that are real stock mentions ($cashtag or ticker + stock context).
method_note.auto_switch_back: every bare run starts with a probe call '$NVDA -is:retweet'; if the tool no longer reports that the $ was removed, the script switches back to cashtag queries

fields.status: exact = every hour of the day so far measured individually (count is exact); partial = some hours exact (exact_part), the rest only bounded; bounded = only an upper bound from the smallest measured group/split node containing the ticker; seen = mentioned in a sample, no count
fields.upper_bound: exact hours + for every other hour the minimum count of a measured (not subtracted) group/node that contains the ticker; null if some hour has no such node
fields.windows_5h: exact window counts (WINDOW_HOURS h each) back-filled from hourly buckets (keyed by window end)
fields.held_back: non-core ticker without clean sample evidence today (>= 3 clean authors, >= 30% clean)
